policiesSlide.title: Policy Summary
policiesSlide.description: This policy affirms the USC's commitment to continuous learning and improvement for all full-time and part-time staff, as well as Executives. It limits the purposes for which professional development will be considered, requires that all opportunities be approved before booking, and recognizes a development program specific to Executives. Details of the approval process are set out in the separate Professional Development Procedure.

useSlide.title: Key Takeaways
items: Applies to all full-time and part-time staff, as well as Executives.
Professional development will be considered for three purposes only: addressing a specific performance concern, fulfilling a job requirement, or learning about new technology or developing skills.
Staff interested in learning opportunities that don't fit one of those categories should consider using their personal courses benefit.
All professional development opportunities must be approved before they are booked.
Meetings, trainings, or conferences that are not pre-approved will not be reimbursed, and may have to be paid back if they were charged to a corporate credit card.
The USC has a development program specific to Executives, and all Executive professional development must also be pre-approved.
The Professional Development Procedure contains the details of the approval process for both staff and Executives.

slideOne.title: 1. GENERAL
slideOne.oneOne: This policy applies to all full time and part time staff, as well as Executives.

slideTwo.title: 2. PURPOSE OF PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

twoOne.intro: Professional development will be considered for the following purposes:
items: 1. To address a specific performance concern;
2. To fulfill a job requirement; or,
3. To learn more about new technology or for skill development.

slideTwo.twoTwo: Staff interested in learning opportunities that do not fit in one of the above categories  should consider use of their personal courses benefit.

slideThree.title: 3. APPROVAL PROCESS
slideThree.threeOne: All professional development opportunities must be approved prior to booking.
slideThree.threeOneOne: Meetings, trainings, or conferences not pre-approved will not be reimbursed and  may be required to be paid back if paid for on a corporate credit card.
slideThree.threeTwo: See the Professional Development Procedure for details of the approval process.

slideFour.title: 4. EXECUTIVE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM
slideFour.fourOne: The USC recognizes the importance of professional development for student leaders and  has created a development program specific to the Executives.
slideFour.fourTwo: All Executive professional development must be preapproved.
slideFour.fourThree: See the Professional Development Procedure for details of the approval process.
